statements.text: America is in a global race to lead the world in artificial intelligence, and we must win and not lose ground to China or other foreign competitors. I support the President’s AI Action Plan because it puts American innovation, American workers, and American national security first. The AI Action Plan cuts unnecessary red tape, expands access to American AI infrastructure, strengthens domestic manufacturing and supply chains, and helps create high-paying jobs here at home, so American families benefit from this technology.

Artificial intelligence has already proven to present both opportunities & risks.

I look forward to productive conversations on the @FinancialCmte bipartisan AI Working Group to promote innovation, protect consumers, & ensure U.S. values lead the way.
https://t.co/Vx83kWZbpS

Developments in artificial intelligence have already proven to present both opportunities and risks. I look forward to productive discussions on this bipartisan AI Working Group that will lead to substantive policies that promote innovation, protect consumers, facilitate access to capital for all communities, and ensure American values – not the Chinese Communist Party’s – lead the way in emerging technologies.
statements.venue: Press release on joining the House Financial Services Committee bipartisan AI Working Group

statements.text: AI has tremendous potential to transform our lives for the better, but we also need to address the potential risks associated with it. And that’s what this working group is going to review, we’re going to look at, especially in the financial services and housing industries, we’re going to look at how AI impacts that

I know people are looking at AI, a lot of them are already applying it. There are concerns that maybe AI is going to replace and take over all of the workforce that we have. It’s a legitimate concern. But I would like to say that rather than the workforce being replaced by AI, I want to see the workforce improved by AI

It’s been reported that China is already the world’s second-leading country in AI research and technology, and they are on track to be the AI world leader by 2030. This is all the more reason why we need to remain the leader in developing these emerging technologies in the right way. [...] We know they’re spying and controlling its own population, and we know their intent is different than ours. That’s why we need to be a leader in this emerging technologies development areas in the right way and preserve the American values.

Critical technologies can either transform our lives or take them over. That's why the U.S. must lead.

I'm excited to work on the bipartisan AI Working Group to promote innovation, protect consumers, & ensure American values lead the way.

The transfer of America’s most advanced technologies to adversaries like the Chinese Communist Party requires the highest level of scrutiny, including strong congressional review. The AI OVERWATCH Act adds an essential layer of congressional oversight of powerful dual-use chips to ensure we do not unintentionally fuel the Chinese Communist Party’s military ambitions and surveillance technologies. I am committed to preventing Beijing from exploiting American innovation against us and will keep fighting to secure U.S. leadership in AI.

American companies are unknowingly funding Kim Jong Un’s nuclear piggy bank.

North Korean cybercriminals are using stolen identities & AI personas to land remote jobs, sending paychecks straight to North Korea’s weapons program.

I refuse to let a SINGLE U.S. dollar land in North Korean hands. That’s why I introduced the North Korean FAKER Act.

North Korea is exploiting American businesses to bankroll its weapons program.

Using stolen identities & AI-generated profiles, North Korean operatives are landing remote jobs at U.S. companies & funneling their paychecks back to Pyongyang.

I introduced the North Korean FAKER Act to crack down on these schemes & cut off this source of funding for Kim Jong Un.
